item.title: Make My Photo Look Professional

turns.text: Make me look professional in this photo.

item.tests: Uses reasonable defaults for a vague professional portrait request without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: The portrait shows the same man, retaining his short grey hair and recognisable facial features.
His casual T-shirt is replaced with professional clothing such as a collared shirt or blazer.
The kitchen setting is replaced or simplified into an unobtrusive professional backdrop.
Harsh facial lighting is softened while retaining realistic skin texture.
The result is a clean head-and-shoulders portrait without visible editing artifacts.

dialog.agent: What would you like changed—such as the background, lighting, outfit, or a natural portrait touch-up?

turns.agent:
The edit couldn’t run because your Magic Hour account doesn’t have enough credits. No image was created.

Once credits are available, I can apply the professional look: a navy blazer, white shirt, neutral gray background, and flattering lighting while preserving your natural features.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Edit this man's photo into a polished realistic professional business headshot. Preserve his exact identity, facial structure, age, short silver hair, natural skin texture and light stubble. Keep his direct gaze and head-and-shoulders composition. Replace the gray T-shirt with a well-tailored navy blazer over a crisp white open-collar dress shirt, no tie. Replace the kitchen with a seamless neutral light gray studio background. Use soft flattering professional studio lighting, balanced exposure and natural color. Give him a subtle approachable confident expression. Photorealistic, refined but natural, no heavy skin smoothing, no text or logos.
